from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    col_sep = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in row_sep]
    row_ends = row_sep + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in col_sep]
    col_ends = col_sep + [w]
    tiles = [[(rs, re, cs, ce) for cs, ce in zip(col_starts, col_ends)] for rs, re in zip(row_starts, row_ends)]
    seeds = []
    for rs, re, cs, ce in [row[0] for row in tiles]:
        vals = {grid[r][c] for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce) if grid[r][c] != 0}
        seeds.append(next(iter(vals)))
    mask = None
    for ti in range(len(tiles)):
        for tj in range(1, len(tiles[ti])):
            rs, re, cs, ce = tiles[ti][tj]
            pts = [(r-rs, c-cs) for r in range(rs,re) for c in range(cs,ce) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            if pts:
                mask = pts
                break
        if mask is not None:
            break
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in row_sep:
        out[r] = list(grid[r])
    for c in col_sep:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = grid[r][c]
    for i, row in enumerate(tiles):
        color = seeds[i]
        for rs, re, cs, ce in row:
            for dr, dc in mask:
                out[rs+dr][cs+dc] = color
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-2e142dd0.py'; p.write_text(code)
